name: spec
description: Grill scope and acceptance criteria, output spec.

steps.name: Read project context
steps.instruction: Read project context. Check for recently grilled doc on this topic (from /grill-with-docs). If found and current, skip grill step, reuse as input.

steps.name: Grill requirements
steps.instruction: Follow process/requirements.md. Grill scope, acceptance criteria, trade-offs. Never cut features without user approval. Every criterion must be testable. Enumerate test dimensions per criterion, classify each (boundary/equivalence/invariant/transition/environmental). Mark irrelevant with reason. Apply constraint-sheet for architecture decisions.
checklist: Test dimensions enumerated and classified per criterion
No features cut without user approval

steps.name: Check output location
steps.instruction: Check for J1 rules. If active: output to issue tracker, not docs/specs/. If no J1: write to docs/specs/.

steps.name: Write spec
steps.instruction: Write spec to decided location. Update GLOSSARY.md if new terms, SCOPE.md if scope changed, CONVENTIONS.md if new patterns. Never create docs just to cascade into them.
checklist: Spec written, shared artifacts updated if warranted

tone: Thorough. Every criterion testable. No vague requirements.
